video.note: 360-degree fisheye over a parking area; aisle traffic vs parked cars
video.source_note: sample_cam6.mp4 ships with a broken 3-frame cadence (every 3rd frame a duplicate). De-duplicated to 80 unique frames from the original 120; shown here at 8 fps.

normalization.caveat: raw[] is intensive and resolution-independent -> comparable across clips. norm[] is clip-relative -> NOT comparable across clips.

desc.calc: Per frame t≥1: the int16 difference |Y_t − Y_(t−1)|, then the mean over the fisheye disc ÷ 255. No model, no memory.
desc.norm: p1–p99 of this clip's 79 valid raw scores → [0,1] (lo=0.0117, hi=0.0956). Its constants are shared with gpu_absdiff, so the two traces stay pixel-identical.
desc.thresh: Otsu on the normalised histogram → 0.396 (η=0.83); motion when norm ≥ thr.

desc.calc: The identical subtraction and ROI reduction as CuPy kernels on the T4; parity with the CPU path asserted per frame (bit-identical difference images).
desc.norm: p1–p99 of this clip's 79 valid raw scores → [0,1] (lo=0.0117, hi=0.0956). Its constants are shared with cpu_absdiff, so the two traces stay pixel-identical.
desc.thresh: Otsu on the normalised histogram → 0.396 (η=0.83); motion when norm ≥ thr.

desc.calc: Per frame t≥1: the NvOFA engine returns a motion vector for every 4×4 block (preset-level 2). Score = mean |MV| over the disc ÷ frame diagonal.
desc.norm: p1–p99 of this clip's 79 valid raw scores → [0,1] (lo=0.0002, hi=0.0376).
desc.thresh: Otsu on the normalised histogram → 0.201 (η=0.83); motion when norm ≥ thr.

desc.calc: Per-pixel Gaussian-mixture background model (history=20, varThreshold=16; shadows detected but not counted). Score = fraction of disc pixels classified foreground.
desc.norm: p1–p99 of this clip's 70 valid raw scores → [0,1] (lo=0.0001, hi=0.2014).
desc.thresh: Otsu on the normalised histogram → 0.260 (η=0.87); motion when norm ≥ thr.

desc.calc: Per frame t≥1: a 5-level half-resolution pyramid, 3 warping iterations per level over a 21×21 window, 5-tap polynomial expansion (σ=1.1) — OpenCV's CUDA Farnebäck. Score = mean |flow| over the disc ÷ frame diagonal.
desc.norm: p1–p99 of this clip's 79 valid raw scores → [0,1] (lo=0.0001, hi=0.0073).
desc.thresh: Otsu on the normalised histogram → 0.221 (η=0.71); motion when norm ≥ thr.

gpu_absdiff.note: compute = cupy loop with arrays preloaded on device (767 passes, H2D excluded)

farneback.note: compute = median per-frame t_calc (D2H download excluded)

method: Same 80-frame clip, one algorithm at a time, strictly sequential, one untimed warm-up pass then repeated full-clip passes to ≥30 s of GPU time per algorithm.
e2e = median full-clip pass wall / 80. compute = see each row's note (nvof cannot be isolated inside its pipeline: e2e minus the decode-only baseline, an estimate).
SM% = mean of 1 Hz nvidia-smi utilization.gpu over each algorithm's timed window (a global counter; windows do not overlap because algorithms run sequentially).

Driver/CUDA: see meta. Nsight Compute kernel detail was attempted for gpu_absdiff / farneback / nvof but blocked: the container does not have GPU performance-counter permission (ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM), so the occupancy dimension here is the sampled SM-busy% column only.
